name: NFC Canary
tagline: A Flipper Zero app that detects unwanted NFC scans
description: NFC Canary is a Flipper Zero app that turns the device into an intrusion canary for NFC — it sits passively and alerts you with a vibration when someone scans your card, badge, or keyfob without permission. For a device best known for attacking NFC, this flips the script and gives defenders a cheap, pocketable way to know when their credentials are being probed.
highlights: Detects NFC scans of your cards, badges, and keyfobs
Alerts via vibration when an unwanted scan happens
Turns the Flipper Zero into a defensive security tool
Simple, practical intrusion detection for physical credentials
curatorNote: The Flipper Zero is the poster child of RFID mischief, so a canary app that detects when your own credentials are being probed is a clever inversion — cheap physical-intrusion detection for the card in your pocket.
